descriptions.02CC: A common herb that grows anywhere. Restores 20 HP.
descriptions.02CD: Neutralizes poison in the body. Bitter and not very tasty.
descriptions.02CE: Apparently made from concentrated herb extract. Because it is often obtained from fairies, it came to be called this. Restores 40 HP and 10 MP.
descriptions.02CF: Crunchy and nutritious. Perfect as a snack with alcohol. Restores 60 HP.
descriptions.02D0: A further concentration of herb extract. Restores 100 HP.
descriptions.02D1: Using this restores every condition except being knocked out.
descriptions.02D2: Its main ingredient is ammonia. Wakes sleeping or unconscious people in one hit.
descriptions.02D3: A liquor made in the cold northern lands. Effective on people with colds or who are frozen. It is written as vodka and read as vodka. Restores 10 HP and a little MP.
descriptions.02D4: A liquor sent by his wife. Besides waking the unconscious, it can thaw frozen people. Fully restores HP and restores some MP.
descriptions.02D5: A common sword, ideal for beginners. Its power is decent.
descriptions.02D6: A broad-bladed sword. A little stronger than a long sword.
descriptions.02D7: A sword that can be used one- or two-handed. Its power is high.
descriptions.02D8: A large sword with a keen edge. Its power is considerable.
descriptions.02D9: A large sword with a wavy blade. A brutal weapon that inflicts deep, repeated lacerations.
descriptions.02DA: A very large sword. It is so heavy that it lowers agility, but its power is immense.
descriptions.02DB: A sword enchanted with ice magic. The blade is cool and pleasant to the touch. Effective against fire-attribute monsters.
descriptions.02DC: A sword enchanted with fire magic. The blade is very hot, so handle it with care. Effective against water-attribute monsters.
descriptions.02DD: A sword enchanted with wind magic. Touching the blade gives a sharp shock, so be careful. Effective against earth-attribute monsters.
descriptions.02DE: A sword made solely to slay a god, as its name suggests. It has the greatest destructive power.
descriptions.02DF: A band wrapped around the arm. Its power is little more than a placebo.
descriptions.02E0: Knuckles that boost punching power. Getting hit by these stings a little.
descriptions.02E1: Iron claws said to be a tiger's. Getting scratched by these stings a little.
descriptions.02E2: An upgraded version of the knuckles. Getting hit by these hurts quite a bit.
descriptions.02E3: Silver claws said to be a silver wolf's fangs. Getting scratched by these hurts a lot.
descriptions.02E4: Metal claws said to be a dragon's. Getting scratched by these hurts intensely.
descriptions.02E5: It is said to grant the user the serene heart of a master martial artist and draw out hidden power.
descriptions.02E6: Gloves imbued with earth magic. Getting hit by these hurts quite a bit.
descriptions.02E7: Gloves imbued with wind magic. A hit leaves a tingling ache for a while.
descriptions.02E8: Gloves said to have been made by a dark demon. A hit hurts so much that no sound comes out.
descriptions.02E9: A staff for someone who has learned only a little magic.
descriptions.02EA: A staff for someone who can use a fair amount of magic.
descriptions.02EB: A staff favored by flame mages.
descriptions.02ED: A staff favored by skilled flame mages. It looks as if it were made just for Karin.
descriptions.02EE: A staff held by a great sage.
descriptions.02EF: A staff imbued with flame magic.
descriptions.02F0: A staff made by an ancient archmage and imbued with the flames of hell.
descriptions.02F1: A whip made of iron chains.
descriptions.02F2: A tool blacksmiths use for work. Not very suitable for combat.
descriptions.02F3: A very long spear for group battles. Not very suitable for individual use.
descriptions.02F4: A light spear with a simple tip. Its power is lacking.
descriptions.02F5: A trident used since ancient times. Three spear blades sit at the end of a long shaft.
descriptions.02F6: A giant fork for combat. A kind of spear with three blades.
descriptions.02F7: A spear with a sharp tip at the end of a long shaft.
descriptions.02F8: A sturdy spear for actual combat.
descriptions.02F9: A weapon combining an axe and a long spear. Sweeping attacks are effective against surrounding enemies.
descriptions.02FA: A spear imbued with the spiritual power of Triton, god of the sea.
descriptions.02FB: A spear imbued with the spiritual power of the goddess Valkyria.
descriptions.02FC: A great spear said to have been used by the gods.
descriptions.02FD: Gloves for going out. White and very light.
descriptions.02FE: Two-fingered gloves with only the thumb separated.
descriptions.02FF: Gloves that reach the wrist. They are stuffed with feathers and very durable.
descriptions.0300: Arm-length gloves for a dinner party.
descriptions.0301: Arm-length gloves trimmed with lace and made of the finest silk.
descriptions.0302: Custom-made gloves for royalty and nobility.
descriptions.0303: Gloves sewn from mithril spun into thread.
descriptions.0304: A coat woven with bird feathers. It has good water resistance.
descriptions.0305: A ring that increases resistance to magic.
descriptions.0306: Armor made of bronze. Its defensive effect is decent.
descriptions.0307: A wooden toy for children. It is a short staff and utterly useless for attack.
descriptions.0308: A lovely walking stick wherever you go. Do not expect much power from it, though.
descriptions.0309: A staff carved with a dizzying spiral pattern.
descriptions.030A: A staff bearing a picture of a cute fairy.
descriptions.030B: A self-defense staff enchanted to silence the opponent.
descriptions.030C: A black gleaming iron staff. Getting hit by this hurts quite a bit.
descriptions.030D: An odd-colored staff streaked with poisonous purple and green.
descriptions.030E: A staff that can make friends with all sorts of people and things?
descriptions.030F: A staff of crystal, utterly clear, that grants the dream of flying through the sky.
descriptions.0310: A magnificent staff studded with diamonds. It is as beautiful as it is powerful.
descriptions.0311: The most basic dagger. Easy to handle and often carried for self-defense.
descriptions.0312: A silver dagger. Only slightly, but it is more effective against dark monsters.
descriptions.0313: A short sword for close combat with a leaf-shaped blade.
descriptions.0314: A dagger whose blade is coated with poison. The poison is powerful, so handle it with care.
descriptions.0315: A knife imbued with sleep magic. A cut from it puts the target to sleep at high probability.
descriptions.0316: A stone sealed with magic in its hilt lets it fly, and its power is immense.
descriptions.0317: A pair of knives engraved with gorgeous carvings. Their edge is superb.
descriptions.0318: A dagger forged and tempered in a foreign land. Its superb smithing is said to have imbued it with light magic.
descriptions.0319: A terrifying dark dagger said to destroy the soul of its victim.
descriptions.031B: Cloth armor stuffed with cotton and quilted. It only softens impacts.
descriptions.031C: Soft leather armor. It is light and easy to move in.
descriptions.031D: Hard leather armor made by boiling it in oil. Its defensive effect is decent.
descriptions.031E: Leather armor with metal rings sewn onto its surface.
descriptions.031F: Leather armor with small iron plates sewn on like scales.
descriptions.0320: An iron breastplate. One of the simplest armors, yet quite effective.
descriptions.0321: Leather armor with small metal pieces sewn onto its surface.
descriptions.0322: Armor made of metal rings linked into chains. It is easy to move in and highly defensive.
descriptions.0323: Armor that covers the whole body in woven wire. It is somewhat harder to move in than chain mail.
descriptions.0324: Armor that covers the whole body in metal plates over chain mail. Both defense and weight are top class.
descriptions.0325: Chain mail imbued with water magic. Strong against water attacks, but weak to fire.
descriptions.0326: Chain mail made of mithril steel. Light, sturdy, and magically resistant.
descriptions.0327: Scale armor made from dragon scales. It has high defense and magic resistance.
descriptions.0328: Plate mail blessed with holy power. Very expensive, but its defense is the highest.
descriptions.0329: The strongest armor, imbued with the power of a god.
descriptions.032A: Easy to move in and a perfect fit.
descriptions.032B: Clothing excellent for stealth. It greatly improves mobility.
descriptions.032C: Perfect for hiding in shadows and stalking prey.
descriptions.032E: A top-quality robe made of special magical fiber. Excellent magic resistance.
descriptions.032F: A military coat used mainly by low-ranking soldiers.
descriptions.0330: Fighting clothes designed for easy movement.
descriptions.0331: A martial arts gi embroidered with a dragon. It has a slight magic resistance.
descriptions.0332: Clothing imbued with the power of the wind djinn, Shin. While worn, it constantly wraps the wearer in wind and dramatically raises mobility.
descriptions.0333: A combat suit worn by first-rate fighters. It boasts top-class defense.
descriptions.0334: Alice's favorite cute dress. Expensive, but the worst possible choice for adventure.
descriptions.0335: Everyday wear for nobles and relatively wealthy families.
descriptions.0336: A silk dress for dinner parties.
descriptions.0337: A red dress with slits and yellow trim.
descriptions.0338: A feathered robe said to have been left behind when an angel descended to earth. Wearing it lets you fly.
descriptions.0339: Cute clothes for children. They only soften impacts slightly.
descriptions.033A: A vest knitted from white yarn.
descriptions.033B: A vestment worn by low-ranking mages. Its defense is almost negligible.
descriptions.033C: A magical robe worn by mid-ranking wizards. Imbued with magic, it offers better defense than ordinary clothes.
descriptions.033D: Clothing favored by those skilled in magic. It holds a little wind magic.
descriptions.033E: A robe imbued with flame magic.
descriptions.033F: Clothing worn by mages who have mastered high magic. Multiple enchantments are layered into this high-performance robe, giving it top-class effects.
descriptions.0340: Clothing said to have been created by a great sage. It boasts the highest defense among clothes.
descriptions.0341: A ring that increases resistance to magic when worn.
descriptions.0342: A magic ring that increases defense when worn.
descriptions.0343: A ring enchanted with fire magic.
descriptions.0344: A ring enchanted with water magic.
descriptions.0345: The wearer gains movement as swift as a gale. Incidentally, the word for gale here is read "hayate."
descriptions.0346: A ring enchanted with earth magic.
descriptions.0347: A ring enchanted with dark magic.
descriptions.0348: A ring imbued with the prayers of a cleric.
descriptions.0349: A bracelet sealing the wind djinn, Shin. Wearing it makes the body light enough to fly.
descriptions.034A: A ring enchanted with dark magic.
descriptions.034B: A ring enchanted with flame magic.
descriptions.034C: A mysterious bracelet that lets the wearer move faster than usual.
descriptions.0366: A magic mushroom that raises HP when eaten. Very delicious.
descriptions.0367: An ancient grimoire that raises MP when read. Very difficult.
descriptions.0368: A precious fruit that increases strength. It apparently tastes strange...
descriptions.0369: A grateful stone that raises defense through the blessing of the gods.
descriptions.036A: A book that increases knowledge when read. Be careful, though: it makes you sleepy.
descriptions.036B: A secret stone that increases resistance to magic.
descriptions.036C: A healing potion packed with magical extract. Restores 30 MP.
descriptions.036D: A flower blooming in the demon realm that is said to restore lost MP when eaten. Restores 100 MP.
descriptions.036E: A holy medicine that cures all conditions and fully restores HP and MP.
descriptions.036F: Something is something. It is nothing other than that. In the end, nobody really knows what it is. And because nobody knows, nobody can use it.
descriptions.0370: A ruby pendant imbued with fire magic.
descriptions.0371: A crystal pendant imbued with water magic.
descriptions.0372: A crystal pendant imbued with wind magic.
descriptions.0373: A golden pendant imbued with earth magic.
descriptions.0374: A pearl pendant blessed by light.
descriptions.037F: Wraps enemies in a blast of flame. The area of effect grows with level.
descriptions.0380: Thaws one frozen ally. Not suitable for defrosting sashimi.
descriptions.0381: Wreathes one ally's weapon in flame and raises attack. It can be stacked, but the caster's ability sets a cap, and the effect decreases each turn.
descriptions.0382: Causes an explosion whose shockwave deals heavy damage to surrounding enemies.
descriptions.0383: Emits a blinding flash that stops enemies in their tracks. It sometimes misses.
descriptions.0387: Summons Ifrit from the fire spirit realm and burns enemies over a wide area.
descriptions.0388: Purifies the blood and heals a body poisoned by toxins. The area of effect grows with level.
descriptions.0389: Generates cold air and freezes enemies. The area of effect grows with level.
descriptions.038A: Raises a fierce blizzard centered on the caster. Nearby sluggish enemies freeze. Also effective against petrification and charm.
descriptions.038B: Cures poison, paralysis, and other conditions. The area of effect grows with level.
descriptions.038C: Temporarily heightens human reaction speed and rains a combo on the opponent too fast for the eye to follow. That is why it is called the Dance of Death.
descriptions.0391: Summons a Snow Dragon from the ice spirit realm and raises a great blizzard. It can freeze enemies over a wide area.
descriptions.0392: Gathers electricity from the atmosphere and strikes enemies with it. The area of effect grows with level.
descriptions.0393: Wraps one ally in wind and raises agility. Anyone under this spell will feel as if their body has become lighter. Stacking is effective.
descriptions.0394: Plays a gentle melody that restores the HP of those who hear it. Its directionality is strong, so it can heal only one person.
descriptions.0395: Stops the vibration of the air around one enemy, preventing them from casting spells. The drawback is that they won't notice even if insulted.
descriptions.0396: Lulls the listener into a dreamy state with a nostalgic melody and leads them into the world of sleep.
descriptions.0397: Anyone who hears this becomes energized and can act one more time. With a baton and a miniskirt, it would be perfect.
descriptions.0398: Calls a Thunder Dragon from the wind spirit realm and drops a storm of lightning over a wide area. It has a paralysis effect.
descriptions.039A: Stops the trembling of the atmosphere and nullifies the spells of everyone present.
descriptions.039B: A terrifying spell that vibrates atmospheric molecules and, with a violent discharge, destroys the molecular bonds of objects.
descriptions.039C: Inverted icicles grow from the ground toward the sky and damage enemies. The area of effect grows with level.
descriptions.039D: Blows a bugle and gives a command. Those who fail to resist cannot help but face the same direction as everyone else. Incidentally, the tune is the army wake-up call.
descriptions.039E: Heals a tired body with the bounty of Mother Earth. The earth goddess is surprisingly stingy and heals only one person at a time.
descriptions.039F: Raises an invisible barrier around the body that reduces damage from weapon attacks. Unfortunately, it has no effect on magic. Stacking is effective.
descriptions.03A0: Calls a toxic substance from underground to damage one enemy and poison them with high probability. The gas smells so awful that allies hate it too. The area of effect grows with level.
descriptions.03A1: Anyone under this spell can walk lightly through the air for a time. Be careful: the effect can suddenly wear off while you are enjoying it.
descriptions.03A5: Calls down a mass of rock said to float high in the sky and slams it onto the heads of enemies.
descriptions.03A6: Restores allies' HP with holy power. The area of effect grows with level.
descriptions.03A7: Wakes one unconscious ally. The HP restored apparently increases in proportion to the caster's ability.
descriptions.03AA: Protects one ally with a magic shield. Allies under this spell gain a large increase in magic resistance. Stacking is effective, but it does not affect weapon attacks.
descriptions.03AB: Uses holy power to cure poison, sleep, and every other condition except loss of HP. The area of effect grows with level.
descriptions.03B0: Generates petrification gas that turns anyone who breathes it into stone. A petrified person will not revive unless Restore, Recovery, or a similar spell is cast on them.
descriptions.03B1: Curses the opponent and stops all of their actions. The curse wears off with time.
descriptions.03B2: Curses one enemy and turns them into a puppet. The victim will attack those who are hostile to the caster.
descriptions.03B3: Summons an ancient evil spirit to deal damage over a wide area and inflict poison, paralysis, sleep, and other effects.
descriptions.03B4: Raises all the body's energy at once, dealing devastating damage with the next turn's attack. A refreshing technique that beats enemies to a pulp.
descriptions.03B5: Drains HP from the target and makes it the caster's own. Taking it from an ally is also fine.
descriptions.03BD: Stops time for a brief moment and slashes the opponent to pieces in the meantime. Naturally, only a ragged scrap is left behind.
descriptions.03C0: A self-proclaimed beauty of justice who burns with anger at Al under the banner of eradicating perverts. No one can stop her now.
descriptions.03C2: A sheltered girl who frets about without really understanding anything. But approach her carelessly and you will get hurt.
descriptions.03C3: A truly troublesome girl who stops men who look like adventurers on the road and challenges them to fights. Countless men have fallen beneath her fists.
descriptions.03CA: A very ordinary slime. Weak, making it ideal practice for beginning adventurers.
descriptions.03CB: A slightly stronger slime. Still just a minor foe.
descriptions.03CC: Not very strong, but it carries poison, so the unprepared should be careful.
descriptions.03CD: It ranks among the stronger slimes, but it has no special abilities, so it is not frightening.
descriptions.03CE: A mere slime, yet it uses sleep magic. Afterwards it gets beaten to a pulp.
descriptions.03CF: A white-furred cat. Apparently a rich family's pet, it is elegant and haughty. Beware its charm.
descriptions.03D0: A cat with glossy black fur. It moves gracefully and is exceptionally strong among cats.
descriptions.03D1: The most common cat, with three colors of fur. It is wild, so it is quite strong.
descriptions.03D2: It slips into houses and steals valuables. A small-time villain, and ultimately a minor foe.
descriptions.03D3: It swaggers through back alleys, glares at passersby, and when eyes meet, threatens them and takes their money.
descriptions.03D4: A cat with tiger stripes. Whether it is close to a tiger is unknown, but it is a little strong.
descriptions.03D5: An aquatic reptile with two heads. Its fangs are poisonous, so be careful. It is apparently possible to tame.
descriptions.03D6: A monster with a human woman's head and chest and a bird of prey's body. It attacks in flocks to hunt prey.
descriptions.03D7: A giant monster that lives underground. It is sometimes worshipped as a god of mines. When angered, it causes earthquakes—a real handful.
descriptions.03D8: A golem built from high-tech alloy and cutting-edge technology—the coolest golem around.
descriptions.03D9: A puppet made of wood. Magic barely affects it, so defeat it with direct attacks.
descriptions.03DA: A puppet made of stone. Magic barely affects it, so defeat it with direct attacks.
descriptions.03DB: An ordinary ghost. Since it is a ghost, slashing does not work. Use magic to defeat it.
descriptions.03DC: A powerful ghost. Only magic works on it, and it drains your HP—a truly vicious monster.
descriptions.03DD: A small winged fairy. Its attack power is low, but it can use healing magic.
descriptions.03DE: A mischievous little fairy. It leads travelers into the world of dreams with sleeping dew.
descriptions.03DF: A villainous mage who controls all undead. His face fills everyone who sees it with dread.
descriptions.03E0: A skeleton soldier. Its defense is not particularly high, but its attack is strong, so strike first to win.
descriptions.03E1: Also called a ghoul. A horrifying monster that eats corpses. Being attacked by it risks paralysis.
descriptions.03EB: A winged evil monster. It is not too tough if you face it calmly.
descriptions.03EC: At a glance it looks much like an imp, but it casts sleep magic, so be careful.
descriptions.03EE: An extremely powerful monster summoned from the dark world. It has the power to drain human HP.
descriptions.03EF: A monster with a human woman's head and chest and a bird of prey's body. It attacks in flocks to hunt prey.
descriptions.03F0: A very ordinary crab living in the deep sea. It comes ashore to spawn, and at that time it becomes extremely ferocious.
descriptions.03F1: The guild boss who ruled Attracta until eight years ago. He controls wild monsters.
descriptions.03F2: A magical beast that looks like a cross between a chicken and a lizard. It looks ridiculous, but it uses petrification gas—a dangerous monster.
descriptions.03F3: A mage who wields dark magic. It uses high-power attack spells.
descriptions.03F4: Mainly knowledgeable in chemistry. It feels more like a scholar than a mage. It uses healing magic.
descriptions.03F5: A small evil fairy. Just as sly as its face, it casts insidious magic and laughs in the shadows.
descriptions.03F7: A low-ranking underling and errand runner. In every sense, the bottom rung of villainy, though its attack power is quite low.
descriptions.03F8: A mage who controls fire and earth. In other words, attack with water and wind.
descriptions.03F9: A crab living in the deep sea. It rarely comes ashore, but it is poisonous, so flee if you see one.
descriptions.03FA: A mage who controls water and wind. Burn it or finish it with earth magic.
descriptions.03FC: The cat of Elizabeth, the second-richest person in Attracta. It weighs 10 kg. Very cute.
descriptions.03FD: A bewitching female monster with bat wings. She uses her alluring charm to seduce enemies and make them allies.
descriptions.03FE: An eternal traveler who came from the far west. His combat power is extremely high, but he guards a certain grave and will not move a step.
descriptions.0400: At first it is a formless slime-like creature, but once attacked it copies the opponent's appearance and abilities.
descriptions.0401: An even mightier monster that commands demons. Its blast-flame magic leaves not even ashes.
descriptions.0402: The lowest-ranked soldier who serves the gods in the heavenly realm. It attacks using magic.
descriptions.0403: A higher-ranking angel than an Angel. Its attack power is naturally greater as well.
descriptions.0404: It once held immense power in the heavenly realm, but that power caused it to be cast down to earth. Its attack power is immense.
descriptions.0405: An angel of middle rank who falls into the demon realm becomes this. It has high MP and commands all demons.
descriptions.0406: An ordinary pirate. It finds merchant ships at sea, attacks them, and steals their valuables.
descriptions.0407: A pirate clan that once terrorized the northern seas. Even now, fallen on hard times, their strength remains. Old tigers keep their claws.
descriptions.0408: A title for those at the highest rank of the heavenly angel hierarchy. Some descend to earth bearing a mission.
descriptions.0409: Born anew from the fusion of angels with mighty power. However, if the fused pair do not work together, it is not so frightening.
